messages:
sam_cs: Heads up 00: we need to roll a short outreach for Wave F: legal updated preview consent and asked for explicit analytics opt-in. Also several accounts asked for SSO. Can CS + Sales + Onboard coordinate?

lee_success: Yep. Suggest: 1) single email combining reconsent + quick 1-question micro-NPS + SSO request link 2) office hours for SSO setup 3) flag any declines as renewal-risk for sales.

mika_onboard: I can host three 30m office hours next Wed/Thu 11am PT. Will record. Need list of orgs that previously failed SSO.

rachel_sales: Sales asks: keep SSO opt-in to avoid audit window churn. If they decline analytics consent, mark them for exec outreach. I'll triage the high-ARR accounts.

ops_bot: [automated] Ticket CS-6020 created: "Wave F consent + SSO outreach". Attachments: waveF_export.csv

sam_cs: Draft email subject: "Action needed: Preview consent update + 2-min feedback" CTA: [Acknowledge] [Reserve SSO office hour] [Request exec check-in]. Draft body in thread.

lee_success: Add line: "No changes to product access. Analytics opt-out only disables workspace telemetry." Also include compliance contact.

mika_onboard: SSO checklist I'll use during sessions: collect IdP metadata, test SP login, confirm admin contact. Will post calendar after copy is final.

rachel_sales: I'll DM you top-6 ARR accounts. Please pre-offer exec check-ins for those.

sam_cs: Plan: send first batch 100 emails tomorrow AM, pause to review responses, then continue. CS to track responses in the ticket. Escalate NPS<=6 or consent declined to renewals@redwood.

ops_bot: [reminder] Follow-up automation scheduled in 48h for non-responders.

lee_success: I'll finalize micro-NPS wording and post copy by EOD.

mika_onboard: Calendar posted. First office hour slot recorded.

rachel_sales: Sent ARR triage.
